dedupe_keys.name: genesys mod jl cross sector energy model

description: GENeSYS-MOD.jl is a Julia implementation of the Global Energy System Model, derived from the OSeMOSYS family. Its research contributors publish the linear optimisation code, model documentation and Julia-specific instructions. Users supply exogenous energy demands, technology capacities and costs, resource limits, trade links and policy constraints. The model minimises total system cost while meeting demands in electricity, buildings, industry and transport, and returns technology investments and inter-sector energy flows. Geographic coverage can range from a household to linked world regions, and the planning horizon follows the input years and time slices. Apache-2.0 source is free. A limitation is that results inherit the user's demand projections and the simplifications of a linear programme. It supports cross-sector capacity planning and energy-transition studies. The catalogue's model-messageix-framework is a separate integrated energy-system framework for comparison; it is not a dependency. No scenario input or optimiser was run.
inputs: Energy demands, technology capacities and costs
name: GENeSYS-MOD.jl cross-sector energy model
notes: G7 G7-1394. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Least-cost investments and inter-sector energy flows
